Plans and pricing

Competitor A offers three plans designed for teams that want to ship faster. Every plan includes unlimited projects, priority email support, and a fourteen day free trial with no credit card required.

Pro plan

The Pro plan costs $29 per user per month when billed annually. It adds advanced analytics, single sign-on, audit logs, and custom roles so larger organisations can manage access with confidence.

Enterprise plan

Enterprise customers get a dedicated success manager, a 99.9 percent uptime commitment, and invoicing options. Contact our sales team to discuss volume discounts and on-premise deployment.
